description: This file defines the Twig EscaperExtension class, which provides escaping functionalities, filters, and node visitors for Twig templates, including deprecated methods for setting environment and escapers.

classes.name: Twig\Extension\EscaperExtension
classes.description: Final class extending AbstractExtension, providing escaping filters, node visitors, and configuration for Twig templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the extension with a default escaping strategy, defaulting to 'html'.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Returns an array with an AutoEscapeTokenParser instance for handling auto-escaping.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns an array with an EscaperNodeVisitor instance for traversing nodes.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Provides escape, e, and raw filters for Twig templates.

methods.name: setEnvironment
methods.description: Deprecated method to set the Twig environment and initialize the escaper runtime.

methods.name: setEscaperRuntime
methods.description: Deprecated method to set the EscaperRuntime instance directly.

methods.name: setDefaultStrategy
methods.description: Sets the default escaping strategy, which can be a string, false, or a callable.

methods.name: getDefaultStrategy
methods.description: Returns the default escaping strategy for a given template name.

methods.name: setEscaper
methods.description: Deprecated method to define a new escaper for a specific strategy.

methods.name: getEscapers
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve all defined escapers.

methods.name: setSafeClasses
methods.description: Deprecated method to set safe classes for escaping.

methods.name: addSafeClass
methods.description: Deprecated method to add a safe class with associated strategies.

methods.name: escapeFilterIsSafe
methods.description: Internal static method to determine if filter arguments are safe, returning 'html' by default.
